title: User management
subtitle: Every user: role, access and status. Import lists, activate accounts and send password links. Superadmin only; every change is logged.
notAllowed: This page is for superadmins only.
repRoomNote: Pick the room of the rep's locality: reps don't vote on F1s from their own locality.
selfNote: You can't change your own role or status.

errors.only_superadmin: This page is for superadmins only.
errors.cannot_change_self: You can't change your own role or status.
errors.room_type_mismatch: The room type doesn't fit the role (base room for Base ERR, locality room for Locality, state room for State).
errors.email_rate_limit: The email sending limit was reached. Try again later or copy the link.
errors.link_failed: Couldn't make the link. Try again.
errors.service_key_missing: The server key (NEW_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) isn't set in the app's settings.
errors.email_exists: Already has an account with this email.
errors.login_not_found: No login found for this account.

import.title: Import a list of accounts
import.subtitle: Name, email, position and room. Accounts are created as "pending" and nobody is emailed until you activate them.
import.step1: Fill in the list: name, email, position, room.
import.step2: Copy the table from Google Sheets or Excel and paste it here, or choose a CSV file.
import.step3: Press "Check the list" to see every row and anything to fix before importing.
import.pastePlaceholder: Paste the list here (with or without the header row)
import.saveAsCsv: That's an Excel file. Save it as CSV (File → Save as → CSV UTF-8), or copy the table and paste it.
import.fileError: We couldn't read the file. Copy the table and paste it instead.
import.nothingToRead: No rows found in the list.
import.tooMany: The list has more than 2,000 rows. Import it in parts.
import.doneText: Created {{count}} accounts as "pending". Activate them in the list below; each person then gets an email to set their password.
import.onlyProblems: Show only rows that need fixing
import.pickRoom: Type the room name and pick from the list
import.partialNote: {{count}} rows have problems and won't be imported. Fix them now or import them later.
import.confirm: This creates {{count}} accounts as "pending". No email is sent now. Continue?

problem.position_unknown: Position not recognised: choose a role.
problem.room_not_matched: Room not found: type its name and pick from the list.
problem.room_ambiguous: More than one room has this name: pick the right one.
problem.room_type_mismatch: The room type doesn't fit the role.
problem.duplicate_in_list: This email appears twice in the list.
problem.email_exists: Already has an account with this email (will be skipped).
problem.invalid_role: This role can't be imported (admins and partners are set up one by one).
problem.login_create_failed: Couldn't create the account. Try again.

link.activatedAndEmailed: Account activated and password link emailed to {{email}}.
link.activatedNoEmail: Account activated, but the email wasn't sent: {{reason}} Use "Copy link" and send it on WhatsApp.
link.copyNote: Send it only to this person (WhatsApp or Signal). It works once and for a limited time, and a newer link cancels it.
link.message:
Hello {{name}},
Your account on the Emergency Response Rooms platform is ready. Open this link to create your password, then sign in with your email:
{{link}}
This link is for you only; don't forward it.
link.copyManual: Copy the text from the box

bulk.emailLimit: The email limit was reached: the rest are active but weren't emailed. Send their links later or copy them.
